name: English
ui.subtitle: OpenAI-compatible AI server: models, API keys and connection
ui.report_tip: Copies the engine, the machine and the latest requests for support, without the key
ui.tps_tip: Generation speed in tokens per second, as reported by the engine
ui.cache_tip: Prompt tokens served from the cache, not read again
ui.layer: Model instructions · added before the System Prompt
ui.layer_ph: Fixed instructions for this model; they go before each request's System Prompt. Empty = none.
ui.cloud_note: Each provider's key is stored on the server and shared through keys with a quota. Its models show up in Models.
ui.name: Name
ui.day_tip: Daily cap (UTC): it resets tomorrow. 0 = no cap
ui.keys_note: Chat uses the active model. “Images” lets the key create or edit images with the server's image model.
ui.ctx_tip: 8192 = system value (the default); any other number = custom. Each model loads with the smaller of its maximum and this limit.
ui.cost_tip: Price per million tokens served; Status shows the estimated cost of the total.
ui.cost_note: Only to estimate the service cost in Status. Cloud models also carry their real cost (usd) per key.
ui.keys_file: A file with the keys, their plans and their usage. Import adds the new ones and updates the ones that already exist; it never deletes any. The file holds the keys in plain text: it is kept like a password.
ui.token_gen_tip: The server makes a random one
ui.log_out_note: Forgets the admin token in this browser.
ui.key_saved_ph: Saved. Enter a new one to replace it
ui.reads_tip: Prompt tokens read ÷ engine read time
ui.usage_wipe_ask: Clear the usage data? The keys' usage counters go back to zero. This can't be undone.
ui.not_keys_file: That file isn't an ia_server keys file
ui.keys_import_ask: Import {0} keys? New ones are added, and the ones that already exist take the name and the plan from the file.
ui.not_saved_model: Couldn't save: model not valid for this function
ui.busy_ask: {0} answer(s) in progress would be cut. Continue anyway?
ui.engine_ask: Change the engine to {0}? The model restarts for a few seconds.
ui.no_data: The data didn't load · reload the page
ui.engine_note: Official {0} ({1}): a prebuilt binary for this machine. On change, the server downloads it if missing, verifies its sha256, checks the GPU and each model's parameters, tests it with the first active model and applies it live; if anything fails, it returns to the previous version. Two channels: stable (with release notes) and nightly (several a day).
ui.engine_hand: Manual install: download {0}<version>{1} and unpack it inside {2}; it creates its own folder. After a reload it appears in the selector, and “Change” verifies it and applies it live. Do not edit config.json by hand while the server runs: the panel rewrites it.
ui.about_text: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server for chat, vision, images and cloud providers.
ui.about_foot: The panel is available on the local network only; it is not exposed to the internet.
ui.draw_note: A text model creates images by calling the {0} tool; the server runs it with the chosen model.
ui.no_models: No text models. Add one with +.
ui.pulse_top: Mean {0} tok/s generation · max queue wait {1} ms
ui.usage_reset_ask: Reset this key's usage? The quota is fully restored.
ui.revoke_ask: Revoke this key? It stops working right away.
ui.rotate_ask: Rotate this key? The current one stops working right away; name, plan and usage are kept.
ui.token_ask: Change the admin token? The current one stops working right away.
ui.token_note: Update everything that used the previous token (other browsers, scripts); tools that read it from config.json keep working.
ui.cat_where: Copy each model into its own folder: {0}. The .gguf goes there, with its vision projector (mmproj) in the same folder if it accepts images. This only catalogs it: no file is uploaded.
ui.cat_caps: Capabilities (checked = allowed if the model supports it)
ui.cat_adv: Advanced (JSON): the other fields of the entry
ui.cat_del_ask: Delete {0} from the catalog? Its files stay in the folder.
ui.cat_bad_json: The advanced JSON is not valid
ui.cat_no_engine: There is no video engine yet: it stays in the catalog, not served.
ui.cc_note: The server's own catalog: the context it reports for each cloud model. Order: the provider's list, what the provider reports, the model's own window, then the provider's default.

ui.help_status:
Server status: engine, machine, requests in progress and today's usage.
The monitor shows GPU usage and temperature live; Activity lists the latest requests with their speed.
ui.help_models:
Models served by this server.
▶ loads a model and ⏹ stops it; a model is never stopped while it answers.
✏️ edits its entry: type, file, vision projector, engine arguments, capabilities and sampling.
+ adds a local model: first copy its .gguf into its own folder inside the models folder.
Image generation: which model creates and which edits images when a text model calls the generate_image tool.
ui.help_cloud:
Cloud providers served through this server. Each provider's key stays on the server; clients use their own keys with a quota.
Test checks the key and the balance with a minimal request.
Cloud catalog: the context the server reports for each cloud model.
ui.help_api_keys:
Keys for clients. Each key has a token quota, a validity in months and an optional daily cap.
“Images” lets the key create or edit images.
A key is shown only once, when it is created or rotated.
ui.help_connection:
Addresses for OpenAI-compatible clients: on the local network and, if set, the public URL.
Test connection checks that the server answers.
ui.help_engine_update: Inference engine (llama.cpp). Choose an installed version, the stable one or the newest nightly: the server downloads it, verifies its sha256, tests it with the active model and applies it without stopping the service. If it fails, it returns to the previous one.
ui.help_server:
Public URL: the server's external address, if any.
Concurrent requests: how many answers are generated at once.
Max context at load: the context limit per conversation; each model uses the smaller of its trained maximum and this value.
ui.help_pricing: Reference cost per million tokens, only to estimate the service cost in Status. Cloud models also record their real cost per key.
ui.help_usage_data: Accumulated usage statistics. Clearing them resets the counters of every key; it cannot be undone.
ui.help_user_keys:
Export saves every key with its plan and usage to a file. Import adds new keys and updates existing ones.
The file holds the keys in clear text: store it like a password.
ui.help_security: The panel's admin token. When it changes, the previous one stops working at once in every browser and script.
